correction.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 the ruler's WAL supports Prometheus writeNotify: remote-storage WAL readers are notified when samples are appended instead of polling. The PR says this changes default behaviour slightly. Nothing is said to fail.

consequence.statement: Ruler remote-write WAL reading changes timing: readers are notified when samples are written. Per the PR, without notify the next read happens only at the next readTicker tick. Existing setups keep working; check ruler remote-write latency and CPU behaviour after upgrading.
consequence.remediation: No action required; optionally check ruler remote-write timing and CPU usage after upgrading.
